system.description:
Command is the ability to deliver curt and effective orders on the field of battle. A character’s “command radius” only stretches as far as the sound of his voice—a fairly short distance on the battlefield. But to those around them, a commander can be a great boon.

Obstacles: Command can be used to negate hesitation of characters in battle. The obstacle is the amount of hesitation. Margin of success is subtracted from all hesitation within the Commanding character’s presence. Obviously, the Commanding character can’t be hesitating during this. In the Range and Cover mechanics, a Command test vs the highest Will on your team may count as a linked test for the team members’ field maneuvers.

FoRKs: Oratory, Conspicuous

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Root: Will

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 265
